EvidenceNeed.description: A piece of evidence the run still needs, with its resolution status.

acceptable_source_kinds.description: Source kinds the requester would accept for this need; empty means any (not yet used to filter sources).
acceptable_source_kinds.title: Acceptable Source Kinds

category.description: Which kind of evidence would satisfy the need.

id.description: Stable id of the need; answers and coverage are keyed by it.
id.title: Id

priority.description: Whether the need blocks resolution (required) or only improves it (supporting).

question.description: What the evidence must tell the run.
question.title: Question

resolution.description: Notes on how the need was resolved, such as why no source could serve it.
resolution.title: Resolution

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

status.description: Whether the need is open, satisfied, partly met or cannot be met.

EvidenceNeed.title: EvidenceNeed

OptionContext.description: One option the decision researches for: what it is and what it already cites.

cited_refs.description: Evidence ids plus any file paths or symbol names the option's text mentions.
cited_refs.title: Cited Refs

description.description: What the option means, used as query text beside the title.
description.title: Description

human_added.description: True for an option a human added: its claims are unverified and research checks them.
human_added.title: Human Added

option_id.description: Id of the option research is gathering evidence for.
option_id.title: Option Id

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

title.description: The option's short name, used as query text.
title.title: Title

OptionContext.title: OptionContext

answer_requirements.description: Original answer obligations; the neutral adapter validates their typed contract.
answer_requirements.title: Answer Requirements

assessment.description: Scoped supplied evidence interpreted conditionally by the neutral retrieval port.
assessment.title: Assessment

criteria_context.description: The approved criteria's questions, used as query text beside the goal.
criteria_context.title: Criteria Context

evidence_needs.description: Specific pieces of evidence to find; empty means Jev chooses the categories to search.
evidence_needs.title: Evidence Needs

evidence_needs_only.description: Research exactly the given needs: Jev adds no further evidence categories.
evidence_needs_only.title: Evidence Needs Only

existing_evidence_ids.description: Evidence already held, so research does not fetch or count it twice.
existing_evidence_ids.title: Existing Evidence Ids

expected_coverage.description: Whether every required need must be satisfied (all_required) or partial coverage is acceptable (best_effort).
expected_coverage.title: Expected Coverage

gaps.description: Open unknowns (synthesis gaps, research unknowns, option-design feasibility facts); the first research.max_targeted_needs of them become targeted needs.
gaps.title: Gaps

jev_reserve.description: Jev calls the requester keeps for itself afterwards (its final assessment); research plans no more needs than the rest of its budget affords and never spends into this reserve.
jev_reserve.title: Jev Reserve

option_context.description: The options the decision has so far (empty before options exist); research reads it.
option_context.title: Option Context

question.description: The question research must find evidence for.
question.title: Question

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

source_restrictions.description: Ids of the only sources research may use; empty means no restriction beyond the run's scope.
source_restrictions.title: Source Restrictions
